They compete in group III of the [[III liga]] in the [[2026–27 III liga|2026–27 season]], following relegation from the [[2025–26 II liga]]. The club was established in 1945. It has won [[Polish Cup]] four times (1962, 1963, 1977, 1978), and has finished as runner-up in the Polish championship four times (1955, 1964, 1967, 1972). Apart from football, the organization of Zagłębie has other departments, such as ice-hockey ([[KH Zagłębie Sosnowiec]]; five times Polish champion: 1980, 1981, 1982, 1983, 1985) and men's basketball (twice Polish champion: 1985, 1986)."}}
